notes.title: Announcing 'Little Aviary'!
notes.content: [p]Hello! [/p][p]Welcome to Little Aviary![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576294/2e30f5124af846bfd8c954983bfcb008fdc5168d.gif"][/img][/p][p]After my first game Tranquil Isle I wanted to stick to the general cozy genre but wanted to do something even more cozy, so decided an idler would be a good fit. I also wanted to make a creature collector and my partner is an avid bird watcher so that’s where Little Aviary was born! [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="fkaqtTMXwJY;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]What to expect:[/p][list][*][p]birds[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]A big thank you to [url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/Mooncube/"]Mooncube Games[/url] for including the game into the Back to School celebration for the announcement! Be sure to[url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/Mooncube/sale/BacktoSchoolGamesCelebration2025"] checkout all the other cool games in the event[/url], I’m so happy to be included with such great company! [/p][p][/p][p]I'm also starting a playtest for the game this week and I'd love to get as much feedback as possible so please sign up if you're interested![/p][p][/p][p]I hope you have a good time with Little Aviary! 💙[/p][p][/p][p]- Tom[/p][p][/p]
